title: Suppress distance-worsening actions
frozenQuestion: Does transparently rejecting an otherwise valid proposal whose exact selected distance increase exceeds a declared threshold reduce completion or increase successful-run cost in S09 barrier contexts?

intervention.onlyDifference: After authoritative proposal construction and mechanical validation, reject an eligible proposal exactly when its committed successor would increase the selected exact metric numerator by more than the threshold.
unchanged: initial structural and byte-exact mutable state
counter-addressed actor and raw Bubble-side opportunity tokens
intervention.ineligibleProposals: No-op, mechanically rejected, and conflict-lost proposals are never suppressed. Eligible memory updates have zero occupancy distance delta and pass.
intervention.terminalConvention: Native E01 complete/quiescent/event-budget evaluation is unchanged and does not relabel a filter-disabled active state as quiescent. Exact filtered-graph reachability supplies the separate impossibility label.

primary.rule: suppress every strictly distance-worsening eligible proposal

sensitivity.rule: allow a one-raw-unit increase and suppress only larger increases; metric units remain explicit and are not treated as comparable scales

cohort.primary: Every one of the 25,224 S09 persistent-arm retained trajectories (baseline, remove, move, and add) under all four primary metric filters.
cohort.thresholdSensitivity: All 3,328 distinct persistent structural contexts on S09 replicate 0 under all four metrics at threshold 1.
cohort.activationPulseBoundary: The S09 activate arm is excluded because it contains a time-varying barrier intervention and has no persistent S07 family; including it would violate the filter-only S10 intervention and exact-reachability contract.

pairing.control: Replay the exact S09 unfiltered persistent scenario and require equality with the frozen S09 row and trace digest before pairing.
pairing.cellViewStream: Use the unchanged S09 conditioned counter-addressed coupling key and seed; actor and raw-side tokens must match at every common event index.
pairing.traditionalStream: Deterministic traditional controller; random-stream fields are explicitly not applicable.
pairing.preDivergence: Every proposal, decision, pre/post dynamic state, and ledger delta before the first suppressed proposal must equal the control. At the first divergence, the proposal and pre-state must still be identical and only the filter decision may differ.

strata.requiredSeparation: Intervention-created exact impossibility, pre-existing exact impossibility, reachable fixed-horizon censoring, quiescent failure, and completion remain separate.

eventBudgets.extensionPopulation: Every replicate-0, threshold-0 filtered run that is active at 2,048 and remains exactly goal-reachable in the filtered S05 graph.
eventBudgets.exactImpossibleConvention: A budget-stopped filtered run proven unreachable is classified as exact impossibility, not completion censoring, and is not extended merely to reconfirm impossibility.
eventBudgets.prefixChecks: Dynamic state, ledger, metric levels, filter audit counters, and common opportunity counters must match at 2,048.

costAndEfficiency.recorded: Full E01 ledger and a named unit-sum descriptive projection for every run.
costAndEfficiency.efficiencyEligibility: Cost efficiency is defined only when both control and filtered runs complete. Other cost differences are labelled spent-cost contrasts.
costAndEfficiency.failureRule: A shorter failed, quiescent, impossible, recurrent, or censored run is never described as efficient.

recording.nativePrefix: Retain native E01 event records through and including the first suppressed proposal so intervention-only pre-divergence identity is byte-auditable.
recording.postDivergence: After declared divergence, continue through the same execute_batch engine in summary mode, preserving proposal, validation, filter, commit, ledger, stream-counter, terminal, and metric semantics while omitting redundant event JSON/state hashing.
recording.noExposure: If no proposal is suppressed, retain the complete native event trace and require equality with the control.
recording.determinism: Replay every filtered run and match the complete final state, ledger, distances, filter audit, opportunity-token digests, retained native prefix, and canonical run-summary digest.

uncertainty: 10,000 deterministic cluster-bootstrap resamples over source structural starts after averaging target placements and scheduler replicates within each declared stratum; finite-corpus heterogeneity intervals, not superpopulation inference.
hardStops: any primary persistent S09 trajectory or declared structural context is lost
any unfiltered replay differs from the frozen S09 result
any scenario, initial state, actor token, or raw-side token differs within a pair
any proposal/state/ledger difference occurs before the first filtered decision
any eligible worsening proposal passes or any nonworsening/ineligible proposal is suppressed
any replay, ledger, distance, trace, or input-immutability failure
any reachable replicate-0 primary censored arm lacks its 32,768-opportunity sensitivity
